about_zh: 代理、隧道、DNS、下载——让流量按你的意思走。

repos.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers
repos.summary_zh: 提供每日自动更新的公共 BitTorrent tracker 列表，涵盖 UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket、i2p 和 Yggdrasil 等多种协议。包含域名与 IP 两种格式，通过自动化检测去重，优化 P2P 文件共享的连接效率与稳定性，适用于 BT 客户端配置及去中心化网络应用场景。
repos.summary_en: Daily automatically updated public BitTorrent tracker lists supporting multiple protocols including UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, i2p and Yggdrasil. Provides both domain and IP address formats, with automated deduplication to optimize P2P file sharing connectivity and stability for BT clients and decentralized network applications.

repos.description: edgetunnel2 VLESS/Trojan/SS 多功能面板
repos.summary_zh: edgetunnel 2.0 是基于 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 的边缘计算隧道管理方案，深度集成 VLESS 与 Trojan 协议。提供可视化后台面板，支持实时配置、日志监控与流量统计。内置自动订阅系统，兼容 Clash、Sing-box、Surge 等主流客户端。支持自定义 ProxyIP、链式代理及优选 API 加速，适配 Windows、Android、iOS、MacOS 及软路由固件，部署方式灵活高效。
repos.summary_en: edgetunnel 2.0 is a Cloudflare Workers/Pages-based edge computing tunnel solution with deep VLESS and Trojan protocol integration. It features a visual management panel for real-time configuration, log monitoring, and traffic statistics. The built-in subscription system auto-generates configurations compatible with Clash, Sing-box, Surge and other clients. Supporting custom ProxyIP, chain proxies, and optimized APIs, it accelerates performance across Windows, Android, iOS, macOS and router firmware with flexible deployment options.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift是一款基于JavaScript的网盘直链下载助手，支持百度、阿里、移动、天翼、迅雷、夸克、UC、123云盘等八大主流网盘。通过注入脚本解析页面请求，绕过客户端限制，直接获取文件下载地址，提升下载效率。适用于批量下载或高速下载，亮点为多网盘适配、持续更新、开源免费。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based cloud drive direct link downloader supporting eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123pan. By injecting scripts to parse page requests, it bypasses client restrictions and directly obtains file download URLs, improving download efficiency. Suitable for batch or high-speed downloads, featuring multi-drive compatibility, continuous updates, and open-source free.

repos.description: 最好用的 V2Ray 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本
repos.summary_zh: 233boy/v2ray 是一款专注于 V2Ray 自动化部署与管理的 Shell 脚本工具。通过极简命令行交互，实现一键安装、配置管理与协议切换，大幅降低 V2Ray 使用门槛。核心亮点包括多协议支持（VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks）、自动化 TLS 证书申请、多配置并行运行及动态端口管理。适用于快速搭建科学上网代理服务器，满足隐私保护与网络访问需求。
repos.summary_en: 233boy/v2ray is a Shell script tool focused on automated deployment and management of V2Ray. It simplifies complex configurations through minimal command-line interactions, enabling one-click installation, configuration management, and protocol switching. Key features include multi-protocol support (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks), automated TLS certificate provisioning, concurrent multi-configuration operation, and dynamic port management. Ideal for rapidly deploying scientific上网 proxy servers for privacy protection and network access needs.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的电子书清单（多个学科，含下载链接）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是'编程随想'博主整理的跨学科电子书库，涵盖政治、技术等多个领域。核心亮点在于采用Resilio Sync P2P技术实现去中心化分发，支持免翻墙自动同步，规避审查与流量限制。提供PDF/EPUB/MOBI等全格式支持，并附带详细的阅读技术指南，构建了一个抗审查的数字知识分发体系。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts cross-disciplinary e-books curated by 'ProgramThink', covering politics, technology, and more. Its core innovation leverages Resilio Sync P2P technology for decentralized distribution, enabling censorship-resistant, auto-syncing downloads without VPN. It provides comprehensive format support (PDF/EPUB/MOBI) and detailed technical guides, forming a robust anti-censorship digital knowledge dissemination system.

repos.description: Technitium DNS Server
repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: nodejs-argo是一个强大的Argo隧道部署工具，专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计。它支持多种代理协议(VLESS、VMess、Trojan)等，有直连协议(Socks5、Hysteria2、Reality)可选开启，并集成了哪吒探针功能
repos.summary_zh: nodejs-argo是一个专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计的Argo隧道代理部署工具，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等多种协议，并集成哪吒探针功能。基于Node.js实现，支持环境变量配置的固定/临时隧道、订阅生成及自动保活，适用于个人代理节点搭建。核心亮点包括多协议兼容、哪吒监控集成及npm模块化部署。
repos.summary_en: nodejs-argo is a powerful Argo tunnel deployment tool designed for PaaS and game toy platforms. It supports multiple proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess, and Trojan, with integrated Nezha probe functionality. Built on Node.js, it enables easy configuration via environment variables for fixed or temporary tunnels, subscription generation, and auto keep-alive, ideal for personal proxy node setup on cloud platforms. Key highlights include multi-protocol support, Nezha monitoring, and npm package deployment.

repos.description: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
repos.summary_zh: wzdnzd/aggregator 是一个一站式免费代理池构建平台，支持从 Telegram、GitHub、Google 等多源爬取代理资源，自动验证活性与质量，聚合后转换为 Clash、V2Ray、SingBox 等客户端格式。提供 process.py 完整配置与 collect.py 简化两种模式，具备插件系统、多线程并发及 Gist 等灵活存储。适用于个人免费代理获取、机场订阅收集和自动化代理管理场景，核心价值在于高效多源爬取、智能验证与多协议兼容输出。
repos.summary_en: wzdnzd/aggregator is a one-stop platform for building free proxy pools. It crawls proxy resources from Telegram, GitHub, Google and other sources, automatically validates activity and quality, aggregates them, and converts to formats like Clash, V2Ray and SingBox. It offers full-featured process.py and simplified collect.py modes, with plugin system, multi-threading, and flexible storage backends like Gist. Ideal for personal proxy needs, subscription collection and automated management, highlighting efficient multi-source crawling, intelligent validation and broad protocol support.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
repos.summary_en: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

repos.description: A script allowing you to download images and videos from Telegram web even if the group restricts downloading.
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本是一款Telegram网页端用户脚本，可突破群组下载限制，实现图片、视频、GIF及音频等媒体的无损下载。支持私聊、频道及故事内容，通过注入页面解锁下载按钮，兼容主流浏览器及脚本管理器。无需后端服务，适用于需备份Telegram受限媒体资源的用户。
repos.summary_en: This user script bypasses Telegram web's download restrictions to save images, videos, GIFs, and audios from chats, stories, and private channels. It injects into pages to unlock download buttons, compatible with major browsers via script managers like Tampermonkey. Lightweight and backend-free, it efficiently backs up restricted Telegram media content.

repos.description: 最好用的 sing-box 一键安装脚本 & 管理脚本，自动创建 Hysteria2 协议；支持 TUIC，Trojan，REALITY 等所有常见的协议
repos.summary_zh: 233boy/sing-box 是 sing-box 的最佳一键安装与管理脚本，支持 VLESS-REALITY 默认及 TUIC、Trojan、Hysteria2、Shadowsocks 等所有常见协议。核心价值在于高效自动化部署与管理：一键添加/更改配置、自动 TLS、多配置并行运行、零学习成本。适用于 Linux 服务器快速搭建安全代理服务，实现网络隐私保护与访问优化。技术亮点包括 BBR 启用、Caddy 伪装集成、兼容 sing-box 命令，设计强调高效率与极易用。
repos.summary_en: The 233boy/sing-box repo offers the ultimate one-click installation and management script for sing-box. It supports VLESS-REALITY by default and all common protocols including TUIC, Trojan, Hysteria2, Shadowsocks 2022, and various WS/H2/QUIC variants with TLS. Core value is high-efficiency automation for multi-config operation, one-click protocol addition and config changes, auto TLS, and BBR activation. Ideal for quickly deploying secure proxy servers on Linux for privacy protection and network optimization. Highlights include zero learning curve, Caddy fake site integration, full sing-box command compatibility, and powerful shortcuts.

repos.description: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议
repos.summary_zh: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
repos.summary_en: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

repos.description: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Proxy 是专为 Google Antigravity AI 编辑器设计的 Windows 透明代理注入工具。通过 DLL 注入（version.dll 等）和 MinHook 钩子，精准劫持 language_server、node.exe 等进程的网络流量，强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需 Clash TUN 模式。核心价值在于进程级流量控制，避免全局代理影响本地开发，解决中国用户系统代理不生效痛点。支持详细日志诊断与 IP 出口检测，C++17 实现，部署简单。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows-specific transparent proxy injector tailored for Google's Antigravity AI-powered agentic IDE. It uses DLL injection (e.g., version.dll) and MinHook to hijack network traffic from Antigravity processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP proxy routing without TUN mode. This enables selective proxying for Chinese users facing system proxy bypass issues, avoiding global traffic impact. Features C++17 implementation, detailed logging, IP diagnostics for location restrictions, and easy deployment to the app directory.

repos.description: The Public Suffix List
repos.summary_zh: 公共后缀列表（PSL）是互联网基础设施的关键组件，定义了用户可直接注册域名的公共后缀（如.com、.co.uk）。它支撑浏览器Cookie安全策略，防止恶意跨站访问，被所有主流浏览器和网络库广泛采用。项目由志愿者维护，遵循严格审核流程，确保域名系统与开发者生态的精准衔接。
repos.summary_en: The Public Suffix List (PSL) is a critical internet infrastructure component that defines all publicly registrable domain suffixes, such as .com, .co.uk, and .pvt.k12.ma.us. It enables browsers and network libraries to implement secure cookie scoping, preventing cross-site request forgery and other security vulnerabilities. This volunteer-maintained project provides the definitive bridge between ICANN's domain name system and real-world developer needs through strict validation guidelines and community-driven updates, ensuring universal acceptance across the web ecosystem while maintaining meticulous accuracy through a rigorous PR review process.

repos.description: A high-performance proxy pool gateway. Turn massive proxy subscriptions into a stable, smart, and observable network with sticky sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Resin是一款高性能智能代理池网关，将海量代理订阅聚合为支持粘性会话的稳定统一入口。它支持10万+节点管理，通过被动+主动健康检查和P2C+延迟加权算法实现智能调度与熔断。提供HTTP/SOCKS5正向代理及反向代理接入，内置Web UI和结构化日志实现可观测性。具备订阅去重、热更新、状态持久化、零侵入账号提取等特性，基于Go构建高并发，适用于企业稳定IP绑定场景。
repos.summary_en: Resin is a high-performance intelligent proxy pool gateway that aggregates massive proxy subscriptions into a stable, smart, observable unified entrypoint with sticky sessions. It manages 100k+ nodes using passive+active health checks, P2C algorithm, and domain-aware latency-weighted scoring for optimal routing and circuit breaking. Supports HTTP/SOCKS5 forward proxies and URL reverse proxy, with Web UI, metrics, and structured logs for observability. Features include cross-subscription deduplication, hot reload, persistence, and header-based account extraction. Built in Go for native high concurrency, it supports diverse protocols and formats, ideal for stable outbound IP business scenarios.

repos.description: aimili-vpngate是一个借助vpngate.net让Linux用干净ip出站的代理工具。
repos.summary_zh: aimili-vpngate是一款面向Linux VPS的VPNGate节点管理与代理网关工具，基于Python标准库实现节点自动获取、检测与切换，提供HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5多协议代理及Web管理后台，支持一键安装与Docker部署，适用于需要干净IP出站的跨境网络场景。
repos.summary_en: aimili-vpngate is a VPNGate node management and proxy gateway for Linux VPS, built with Python standard library. It offers HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy, node auto-detection and switching, a web dashboard, one-click install, and Docker deployment for clean IP outbound use cases.

repos.description: a multi node frp webui and for https://github.com/fatedier/frp server and client management, which makes this project a Cloudflare Tunnel/Tailscale Funnel/Ngork platform and agent open source alternative
repos.summary_zh: FRP-Panel 是 frp 的开源可视化管理平台，提供集中式配置、多节点编排与边缘 Worker 部署能力。项目采用 Master-Server-Client 架构，支持 WireGuard 智能组网与动态调度，可替代 Cloudflare Tunnel 等商业服务，大幅简化 NAT 穿透与内网服务暴露的运维复杂度，实现统一认证与实时监控。
repos.summary_en: FRP-Panel is an open-source visual management platform for frp that provides centralized configuration, multi-node orchestration, and edge Worker deployment capabilities. Adopting a Master-Server-Client architecture, it supports WireGuard smart networking and dynamic scheduling, serving as a self-hosted alternative to commercial services like Cloudflare Tunnel. The platform significantly simplifies NAT traversal and internal service exposure operations while enabling unified authentication, real-time monitoring, and zero-configuration credential distribution across distributed environments.

repos.summary_zh: VoHive是面向EC20 4G模组的代理管理平台，支持短信收发、多卡eSIM管理、网卡绑定代理、多Bot控制及VoWiFi功能。支持一键安装与Docker部署，兼容ModemManager。适用于多模组代理与短信服务场景，亮点是设备绑定代理与运维自动化。
repos.summary_en: VoHive is an integrated management and proxy platform for Quectel EC20 4G modules. It enables SMS sending and receiving via web or bots, multi-SIM card management, eSIM profile add/switch/delete, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies strongly bound to device network cards, remote control using Telegram, Feishu or QQ bots, and VoWiFi activation with simulated outgoing calls. The platform supports easy one-click installation on Linux or Docker deployment and is compatible with ModemManager. It is suitable for scenarios involving multiple modems for SMS services and proxy pools. Its technical highlight lies in hardware-level device binding for proxies and automation in operations.

repos.description: Reality协议目标网站检测工具 - 一键检测网站是否适合作为Reality协议目标，支持TLS检测、地理位置分析、CDN识别等功能
repos.summary_zh: RealityChecker是专为V2Ray Reality协议设计的目标域名检测工具。通过多维度扫描（TLS 1.3/X25519支持、证书有效性、SNI匹配、CDN识别、地理位置及被墙检测），快速筛选出适合作为Reality目标的优质域名。支持批量检测与智能报告，有效规避热门网站和CDN风险，是搭建稳定代理服务的必备工具。
repos.summary_en: RealityChecker is a specialized domain validation tool designed exclusively for V2Ray Reality protocol. It performs comprehensive multi-dimensional scans including TLS 1.3/X25519 support verification, certificate validity and SNI matching checks, CDN detection, geolocation analysis, and GFW blocking status assessment. The tool enables batch processing of domains and generates intelligent reports to identify optimal Reality targets while filtering out high-risk candidates such as popular websites and CDN-hosted domains. With its ability to detect subtle technical characteristics, it serves as an essential utility for building stable, secure, and high-performance proxy configurations.

repos.description: 【域名扫描器】一个用Go语言编写的强大且灵活的域名注册可用性检查扫描工具 A powerful and flexible domain name availability checker written in Go. This domain scanner helps you find available domain based on various patterns and filters.
repos.summary_zh: Domain Scanner 是一款用 Go 语言编写的高性能域名可用性扫描工具。支持字典导入与模式生成，通过 DNS、WHOIS、SSL 多维度验证域名状态。内置 ReDoS 防护、智能并发控制与资源预估，有效防止大规模扫描风险。适用于域名投资与品牌保护工作，提供精准结果与安全保障。
repos.summary_en: Domain Scanner is a high-performance domain availability checker written in Go. It supports dictionary import and pattern generation, verifying domains through DNS, WHOIS, and SSL multi-dimensional checks. Features include ReDoS protection, intelligent concurrency control, and resource estimation to prevent large-scale scan risks. Ideal for domain investors and brand protection, delivering precise results with robust security guarantees and efficient scanning capabilities.

repos.description: 万物皆可搭节点 | Everything can be a proxy node
repos.summary_zh: one-node 是一个极简化的网络代理节点部署工具，核心理念是'万物皆可搭节点'。它允许将任意设备快速转换为功能完整的代理服务器，支持多种协议和平台。通过轻量级架构设计，实现一键部署和灵活配置，适用于个人隐私保护、企业内网访问、网络加速等场景，大幅降低代理节点搭建的技术门槛和运维成本。
repos.summary_en: one-node is a minimalist network proxy node deployment tool embodying the philosophy 'Everything can be a proxy node'. It enables rapid conversion of any device into a fully functional proxy server, supporting multiple protocols and platforms. With its lightweight architecture, it offers one-click deployment and flexible configuration for scenarios including personal privacy protection, corporate intranet access, and network acceleration, significantly reducing technical barriers and operational costs.

repos.description: 翼龙面板node.js环境 部署：xHTTP版 Argo双模固定隧道quic/http2、临时隧道；直连hy2、tuic、reality
repos.summary_zh: 翼龙面板Node.js部署环境，支持Argo双模隧道（QUIC/HTTP2）、TUIC、Hysteria2及VLESS-Reality等代理协议。针对64MB低内存平台深度优化，内置6级自适应匹配与主动内存回收机制，兼容多个免费托管平台，适用于网络运维与抗封锁场景。
repos.summary_en: Node.js deployment environment for Yilong Panel supporting Argo dual-mode tunnels (QUIC/HTTP2), TUIC, Hysteria2, and VLESS-Reality proxy protocols. Deeply optimized for 64MB low-memory platforms with 6-level adaptive matching and active memory reclamation, compatible with multiple free hosting services for network operations and anti-blocking.

repos.summary_zh: AetherGate Pro 是企业级高可用 VPN 与代理网关管理工具，专为 Linux VPS 设计。通过网络命名空间（netns）隔离技术，避免主机接口污染和 SSH 断连问题。支持单端口混合 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，自动抓取 VPNGate 节点并过滤欺诈风险，配备玻璃拟态仪表盘与自愈看门狗，实现稳定可靠的代理服务，适用于代理网络工程师构建企业级网关。
repos.summary_en: AetherGate Pro is an enterprise-grade, high-availability VPN and proxy gateway manager for Linux VPS. It uses network namespace (netns) isolation to eliminate SSH disconnections and routing conflicts on the host. It features a single-port mixed SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, auto VPNGate scraping with fraud filtering, a glassmorphic dashboard, and self-healing watchdog for seamless, reliable proxy services tailored for network engineers.

repos.description: 一个用Go语言编写的性能强大的域名可用性检查扫描工具 A high-performance domain availability scanning tool written in Go.
repos.summary_zh: PowerWhois 是一款基于 Go 语言的高性能域名可用性扫描工具，支持百万级批量查询与 Web/API 双模式。其核心亮点包括 Mix 模式灵活调度直连、代理与 DNS 查询，支持自定义 WHOIS 与注册 API 集成，适用于域名投资与注册商业务场景。采用 Gofiber+Vue3 全栈架构，Docker 一键部署，兼具性能与易用性。
repos.summary_en: PowerWhois is a high-performance domain availability scanning tool written in Go, capable of processing millions of domains with exceptional speed. It offers Web and API operation modes, featuring Mix mode for flexible direct/proxy/DNS query scheduling, custom WHOIS/registration API integration, and typo generation. Built on Gofiber backend and Vue3+Quasar2 frontend, it serves domain investors and registrars with Docker deployment.

repos.summary_zh: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) 是 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级隧道代理工具，支持 VLESS 和 Trojan 协议。模块化 ESM 架构支持 Wrangler 部署、KV 配置与订阅生成。核心价值为工程化 Serverless 代理方案，易扩展二次开发。适用于网络代理与边缘计算场景，性能依托全球边缘网络。
repos.summary_en: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) is a lightweight tunnel proxy tool on Cloudflare Workers supporting VLESS and Trojan protocols. It uses a modular ESM architecture for easy Wrangler CLI deployment, local debugging, and Git version control. Configuration is managed via Cloudflare KV, with automatic subscription link generation for clients like Clash and Sing-box. The core value is an engineering-friendly, extensible Serverless proxy solution ideal for developers to learn Worker development and WebSocket communication. It leverages global edge network for performance in secure tunneling and proxy scenarios.

repos.description: 收集免费机场转成Socks5代理池
repos.summary_zh: airProxyPool是一个自动化代理池项目，通过收集免费机场的SS/VMess代理，使用aggregator验证并由glider提供SOCKS5统一接口。支持自动更新、检测和故障转移，实现高可用代理服务。适用于爬虫和隐私保护场景，简化代理管理流程。
repos.summary_en: airProxyPool is an automated proxy pool that collects free airport SS/VMess proxies, validates them with aggregator, and exposes a unified SOCKS5 interface via glider. It supports auto-updates, checks and failover for high availability, ideal for scraping and privacy scenarios.

repos.description: 华为云 CodeArts Agent OpenAI 兼容代理 · 多账号轮转 + token 自动续期保活 + 并发控制 + WebUI
repos.summary_zh: 华为云 CodeArts Agent（盘古助手）的 OpenAI 兼容代理，纯 Go 实现无需客户端。支持多账号轮转、Token 自动续期保活、并发控制与 WebUI 管理，内置模型可用性探测、每日签到积分自动领取及工具调用支持，可将华为云盘古大模型无缝接入 OpenAI 生态。
repos.summary_en: OpenAI-compatible proxy for Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent (Pangu). Pure Go, no client required. Features multi-account rotation, auto token refresh, concurrency control, WebUI, model probing, daily credit auto-claim, and tool calling support for seamless integration with the OpenAI ecosystem.

repos.description: onekey script to install xray on alpine system
repos.summary_zh: 专为Alpine Linux设计的Xray-core一键安装脚本，自动从官方GitHub下载最新版本，安装至系统路径，配置基础SOCKS代理，并注册为OpenRC服务实现开机自启。适用于轻量级服务器快速部署代理节点，简化Alpine环境下的Xray运维。
repos.summary_en: One-click shell script to install and configure Xray-core on Alpine Linux. Automatically downloads the latest official release, installs the binary, sets up a basic SOCKS proxy, and registers it as an OpenRC service with auto-start. Ideal for lightweight servers needing quick proxy deployment.

repos.description: 利用Deno提供的服务进行代理中转
repos.summary_zh: DenoProxy是基于Deno运行时构建的轻量级动态代理服务，核心能力在于通过URL参数实时配置代理目标，并将/proxy路径请求无缝转发至指定后端。项目采用Deno原生HTTP服务器与KV存储，支持本地运行与Deno Deploy云部署双模式，适用于API调试、跨域请求代理及开发环境网络中转等场景，具备配置灵活、部署极简的技术特征。
repos.summary_en: DenoProxy is a lightweight dynamic proxy service built on Deno runtime, featuring real-time target configuration via URL parameters and seamless request forwarding for /proxy paths. Leveraging Deno's native HTTP server and KV storage, it supports both local execution and Deno Deploy cloud deployment. Ideal for API debugging, cross-origin request proxying, and development environment network tunneling, it delivers flexible configuration and minimal deployment overhead.

repos.summary_zh: llm-tap是一款本地透明代理工具，专为采集真实LLM API交互并构建训练数据集设计。用户将客户端URL重定向至代理，即可透明转发请求至上游服务商，同时原样保存完整调用为JSON文件。支持多协议自动识别、流式响应合并及多服务商。提供Web UI筛选检查，通过导出脚本生成OpenAI、ShareGPT等多种格式数据集，适用于LLM微调与agent训练。亮点为零配置保真存储和按host分类。
repos.summary_en: llm-tap is a local transparent proxy tool designed to capture authentic LLM API interactions for building training datasets. By redirecting client URLs to the local proxy, it transparently forwards requests to upstream providers while saving each complete call as a raw JSON file. It supports automatic protocol detection for OpenAI, Anthropic, and others, merges streaming responses, and handles multiple providers seamlessly. A web UI enables filtering and inspection, while export scripts convert data to formats like OpenAI, ShareGPT, tool_sft, or canonical JSONL for fine-tuning and agent training. Key features include zero upstream configuration, faithful protocol preservation, and host-organized storage.
